 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE CHANDRA SHEKHAR JHA  ORAL ORDER 2 10-07-2025 Heard the parties.
2.

It is submitted by Mr. Ashish Giri, learned senior counsel appearing for the petitioner that the only allegation which is available against this petitioner is to approve the registry of the document where jamabandi number was said to be incorrect.
It is submitted that with this allegation it cannot be said that any prima-facie case qua offences under section 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 427 of the IPC made out against petitioner.
It is further submitted that petitioner at relevant point of time was posted as Sub-Registrar, District- Khagaria and, therefore, before taking cognizance learned Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.34168 of 2025(2) dt.10-07-2025 Magistrate was duty bound to obtain sanctioned report in view of Section 197 of the Cr.P.C.
In this context learned counsel relied upon legal report of Hon'ble Supreme Court as available through Gurmeet Kaur vs. Devender Gupta reported in (2025) 5 SCC 481.

sentences.text: Beside aforesaid it is also pointed out that police after investigation found this case false against petitioner, where while taking different note even reason was not recorded by learned Magistrate.
